decision.presentation_text: Kizzie's knock had barely faded into the evening air before the door swung open with silent precision. The mansion's brass house number gleamed in the last amber light of dusk, confirming the address, while the scent of freshly trimmed hedges mixed with cooling stone. Ayame stood in the threshold, dressed immaculately, her composed smile welcoming as warm light spilled from the marble foyer behind her, a gentle contrast to the settling twilight. Her gaze swept over Kizzie's appearance with polite, practiced appraisal before meeting her eyes. "Ah, Kizzie. Right on time. Do come in—we have much to discuss about your new position."
